entities.name: Chedi Kingdom
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Chedi was a kingdom which fell roughly in the Bundelkhand division of Madhya Pradesh to the south of river Yamuna along the river Ken. Its capital city was called Suktimati in Sanskrit.
